name: 橘猫
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve animation refinement. Create EIGHT actual sequential key poses of the SAME cat, matching the references' exact breed, face, eye color, fur patches, head size, ear shape and tail. Crisp pixel-art, flat authored color clusters, genuine transparent alpha, no scenery, shadow, glow, labels or text. Landscape 2048x1024, exactly FOUR COLUMNS x TWO ROWS, equal cells, each full cat has generous padding with no clipping. Reference1 is character identity, reference2 helps standing/sitting proportions. CONSISTENT HEAD SIZE AND PIXEL SCALE across ALL frames.
TOP ROW = a new deliberate SIT DOWN sequence, all facing LEFT:
1 relaxed standing on all four paws, feet under shoulders and hips, tail curved behind.
2 rear knees bend and pelvis lowers while FRONT PAWS STAY PLANTED, head and shoulders mostly stay in place.
3 haunches contact ground and chest rises toward upright sitting, front paws remain planted.
4 relaxed final seated posture matching reference identity, front paws neatly together, tail rests beside body.
Not reversed standing-up copies: convey weight lowering onto the rear and a small settle.
BOTTOM ROW = TURN IN PLACE from left to right, standing on all four:
1 three-quarter LEFT-FRONT view, head turns toward viewer before shoulders, near paw makes a small repositioning step.
2 straight FRONT view on all four paws, foreshortened torso behind head, tail behind, clear symmetric ear positions but preserve asymmetric face markings.
3 three-quarter RIGHT-FRONT view, shoulders and hips now follow toward right, paws reposition beneath body.
4 full RIGHT SIDE VIEW neutral stand, matching top-left stand but opposite direction; preserve real coat identity.
Turning changes actual perspective of head, chest, body and paws; never reuse a side-view cat flipped for the middle frames. Exactly eight cats with natural anatomy, no extra paws. Calm personality, no exaggerated facial expressions. Cat: 橘猫
